mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers monetary policy accommodation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of payroll employment (above 140,000 thousand) signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals rising inflation that may prompt monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and lack of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS stable or rising) signals a failure of the central bank to contain inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS not falling
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising and FEDFUNDS is not falling.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% annualized, it signals an economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0%.
